name: geometry-class-crossover-controls

rigid-large-few.transition: all Nrep selected primitives receive the frozen F001 moving.delta_x translation

rigid-small-many32.transform: group-unique translation; x=moving.delta_x*(0.35+0.65*(group+1)/32), y/z deterministic +/- segment_size*0.05 offsets

topology-replace25.replaced_subset: first 199 primitives in frozen moving-selection local order
topology-replace25.geometry: deterministic translation plus per-vertex hash displacement

frame_boundary.cpu_generation: inside measured target run_frame wall boundary for candidate and control
frame_boundary.candidate_upload: exact dynamic current-frame triangles uploaded to candidate source template and charged to traversal_maintenance_gpu_us/complete_gpu_us
frame_boundary.vanilla_upload: matching changed full-scene triangle entries uploaded and software BVH rebuild/upload charged in same frame
frame_boundary.builder: unchanged F003 LBVH or F005 grid layout/structure; controlled classes rebuild with builder delta=0

claim_rule: F006 all-class pass permits a generalization mechanism result only; general-dynamic architecture claim additionally requires the candidate to already be rigid-primary under F003/F005/F007

accepted_timing.decision_statistic: median of process-level measured target frames
